text:
leo.sales: Heads-up: HelixHealth procurement needs a tiny assurance packet to unblock PO. They asked for: SOC2 control excerpt, ISO scope note, a signed pen-test attestation, a redacted staging network sketch, and a short KMS/key separation note. Also want to know whether Dedicated + customer-managed KMS changes the price. Need a 1-paragraph reply for procurement.
maria.sec: We can do a redacted SOC2 excerpt and ISO scope statement. Pen-test: we only provide a one-page attestation signed by Security Lead (no full report). KMS note: high-level description of tenant key separation + HSM usage.
ana.devops: If they want scanning, we can spin up ephemeral staging creds and a presigned upload path (7d TTL). On-prem direct access requires SOW + legal + ops signoff. Presign naming: `helix_evidence/<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf`.
sam.eng: I'll draft a redacted network sketch and a 1-page KMS architecture blurb pulled from our encryption playbook. Need ~48h to sanitize.
leo.sales: Any rough pricing text I can use for procurement?
maria.sec: Short: enabling Dedicated and customer-managed KMS is treated as Enterprise-tier (platform fee) plus Dedicated commitment. Typical uplift ballpark: ~15% on list for Dedicated and a one-time integration fee for KMS linkage. Mark as "subject to RevOps/Legal confirmation."
nana.devops: Ops impact: allow ~3 business days for KMS integration + smoke tests when provisioning Dedicated. If they want a formal SOW, ops will draft it.
legal-bot: pen-test-attestation-template.pdf uploaded to internal drive: https://redwood.internal/evidence/pen-test-attestation-template.pdf (uploader: legal-bot).
leo.sales: Draft reply to procurement: "We can provide a compact assurance packet (SOC2 excerpt, ISO scope statement, redacted network sketch, signed pen-test attestation, and a KMS separation note) within ~3 business days. The pen-test attestation requires legal sign-off and may take up to 7 business days for signature. Enabling Dedicated with customer-managed KMS typically requires Enterprise-tier licensing (platform fee), a Dedicated commitment, and a one-time integration charge; we'll confirm exact pricing with RevOps. If you need scanning access we can provision ephemeral staging credentials and a presigned upload link (7-day TTL). We do not share full penetration test reports or raw internal logs; we can provide remediation summaries or POA as needed"
maria.sec: LGTM. Ping me if they push for full reports; we'll decline and offer attestation + remediation summary.
nana.devops: Creating presigned path now; will post masked creds here once ready.
sam.eng: Will upload redacted sketch to presigned path when ready and tag the thread (ETA ~48h).
leo.sales: Thanks all  I'll send and flag pricing as provisional."
